name: They Will Never Stop Hunting You
game_text: <phase>Maneuver</phase>: Spot a Nazgûl to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player’s hand. Exert a companion bearing a ranged weapon X times, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
flavor_text: “‘They’re looking for Baggins, and if they mean well, then I’m a hobbit.’”
